notes: Images 1 and 5 show both 2x40 high-density connectors (J1, J2) with printed pin numbers; HD connector pins with no name printed are '?'. Images 2-4 are top views: two 14-pad castellated edges and a 5-pin connector beside the USB-C; RGB LED and battery connector skipped. Images 6-17 each show a single row (odd or even pins) of J1 or J2 with alternate functions, recorded as single-row connectors ordered by printed pin number. Where a microcontroller port name (Pxx) is printed it is used as label and the HD-connector name is first in functions; printed parenthetical notes such as (JTDO/TRACESWO) are kept as a function. Image 1 prints J2-34 as 'VCC' while images 12-14 print 'VCC/+3V3'; each recorded as printed.
